speech.heard: Bangladesh has 61% arable land, in the USA it is 17%. Bangladesh is the world's highest. This includes land under temporary crops, gardens and temporary fallow but excludes abandoned shifting cultivation. Canada and Australia have just 4%, huge countries but very little is ready for the plow. India has 52%, that is 3.1 times the share in the USA. China has 12% and Japan has 11%. Both sit just above the global median of 10%. Nigeria has 41%, a high share for a large nation including fields left fallow. The leaders, Bangladesh 61%, Denmark 59% and the Gambia 58%. What is your country land?
